description: Individual published closes (percent points), one per series per pricing date a saved demo note needs, used as volatility grid centres when the local FRED graph CSVs (.cache/fred/, gitignored) are absent, e.g. on the deployed app. These are the published observations themselves, not values calculated by QuantProof. No price series are stored.
source: FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv).

attribution.VIXCLS: CBOE Volatility Index: VIX, Chicago Board Options Exchange, retrieved from FRED (fred.stlouisfed.org/series/VIXCLS); FRED marks this series as copyrighted by its source.
attribution.RVXCLS: CBOE Russell 2000 Volatility Index, Chicago Board Options Exchange, retrieved from FRED (fred.stlouisfed.org/series/RVXCLS); FRED marks this series as copyrighted by its source.
